translations.web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
translations.bsb: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up
translations.asv: And behold, a woman that had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bowed together, and could in no wise lift herself up.
